posts.title: Open letter for him
posts.summary: This is an open letter to my knight.
posts.content:
Hi. She chatted me again, saying how frustrated she is, all because of you. She loved you. I know she's serious about you. And if you're not, just have enough respect. Respect her as its the best. Its what it should be right? You both have mistakes. You both ruined your relationship so don't ever blame her ONLY. You should blame yourself also. You always tell her you love her? But why the hell after you broke up you keep on telling the other girl you also love her. Oh cut that crap. Why? Why are you suddenly like this? What happened? I never thought you'd be like this. I knew you. You've been a great friend to me back then. Do I have something to do with this? I like to think this is because of peer pressure but hell, your friends still have respect. A girl needs to be respected. Well, we had quite a past and are you still bitter? Okay, fine. I'll admit it. I hurt you. But, can you hear my version of the story? You always knew yours but please do hear me. Your innocence? I took it away. You were so damn innocent, liking someone from afar. Thinking that she wouldn't ever like you, because you think you're not good enough for her. But, I was so positive. I'm purely innocent and ignorent that time. Can you blame me? I'm young, younger than all of you. You befriended me, thinking I need someone to hold on to. I'm near giving up. My friend lied to me. I don't consider anyone in that four corners a best friend, but her. But then, she betrayed me. You noticed it. That's why you came near me. You befriended me. You got close to me. You just entered trouble. Because of me, you lost your time for her. You should be out there, making efforts for her, so that she could like you back. But then, you're always with me. Your friend liked her too, and your girl might like him soon. But, I know, she likes you! She's jealous of me. I don't know what to do. You became my shoulder to cry on, my older brother I never had, my best friend, the one I could lean on. I wanted to be selfish. But then, our classmated were furious. They told me that I should go away. That I should give way because you promised her something. You promised her that you will be by her side and you will leave. I pushed you. I told you I don't need you. I also have friends, not many, but still. I pushed you away, but you told me you will be by her side and be with me also. I agreed, because I am selfish. But, you still lose your time for her. You keep on going to me. You broke your promise. And then, everything's chaotic. Your friendship with your friend ended. Your girl doesn't want you. My friend came back to me and I'm loosing time for you. But then, you didn't left me, so I told you I'll never leave you. I did everything so that things could be normal. You told me you don't like her anymore. I don't believed you. I doubted you. But then, you proved me you don't really like her. I know she likes you and I'm sad that there's your friend on her side, and not you. I think they are somewhat developing their feelings for each other and you didn't even care. Even for the friendship. But I pushed you. You were bitter but I don't like it. You should be happy. I told you comforting words. I did everything so that you could gain confidence. You never had and I would like you to have it. I told you not to be bitter but better. I told you should be friends. And you obeyed. Finally, you're not bitter. Finally, you don't tell something ill about her. And then witg your friend. I told you you should be friends with him again. That you needed it. Before me, he was your best buddy. And, you obeyed me. Everything's okay. But then, you told me you like me. DAMN. That was it. I never liked you. I don't like you. Maybe yes, but as a friend. I don't want to hurt you. It spreaded because I talked to her so that you two would also be okay. I want to hide it. Its awkward. And I could hear some bad comments. But, its inevitable. The whole room knew about that. You like me. They kept on asking me. But, like I always told you, I don't feel something for you. You were just my friend. You knew me for that short time. You handled me well. Through my worst, my best, and even in my PMS period. You cared for me more than anyone else. You showed me pure and innocent love. You always tell me you like me but I always reply with "you know who I like". Yes, I like someone. And he's close to you so you keep on bashing him. You keep on saying ill about him. You always make sure I'm by your side. Our classmates told me I'm the worst. I'm a traitor. That I shouldn't be the one you like. That it should be her. It shouldn't be me. I lost control. I was innocent, young and ignorant. You know that, that's why you always protect me. I pushed you away due to frustration. You didn't obeyed me. I pushed you again. You didn't go away. I pushed you away. You don't want. I pushed you a hundred times but you won't let me. But then, I told you the most heartbreaking thing you'll hear from a girl you like, "I don't like you. I won't ever like you. You never had a chance on me.". You went away. You avoided me for months. But I missed you. I approached you saying how I miss you, as a friend. But, I think you misunderstood. I'm not dense, I know you still like me, so I pushed you to our friend. You then said you like her so I am happy. But when someone confessed to me he like me, you suddenly went to me, protecting me from possible suitors. But, I pushed you away. I spreaded the news I like someone. And then you, became like this. You were never the same. The confidence I told you to make? Its now overflowing. Making girls cry. You made  my friend cried pails. I will never forgive you for that. You became an assgole I never thought you would be. You know what? I miss you. I miss the old you. I never thought that the young guy who used to be so sweet, so kind and could sacrifice a lot for me will turn to an asshole like you. I am so disappointed. But, somewhat, I blame myself. Do I have something to do with this? I hope I don't. I am the first girl your famiky knew. And I think, I'm the first girl who ruined you. But, I hope I'm not the girl who made you like that. I just hope you'll find the right one who could make you better. Better than what I made you before, but then, I hope she'll not ruin you, the way I did. She cried to me. But, I can't do anything. I can't talk to you anymore. I can't tell you to do this or that because J have no rights! Because we're not the same. You are not the same. You are not the same guy I knew. I'm sorry, but you should also be sorry. For now, goodbye. I wish the best for you.

I told her our story but I didn't tell your name. She told me I should talk to you. But then, I asked her, if she's on my place, what would she do. She told me she'll just leave you behind. And, I think that's the best. So yes, goodbye. I'll let you with that. I just hope you'll be moved. I hope that somebody would be there for you, to change you for the better and keep you that way.

You are a knight in shining armor. You saved me for you thought I was your damsel in distress. But, I'm sorry I'm a queen, waiting for my king. 

Goodbye, Knight.

posts.title: ममता का क़र्ज़
posts.summary: अमर अपने माता-पिता का इकलौता बेटा था। दोनों ने लाड़ प्यार के आँचल में ममता की छाँव तले उसे पालकर बड़ा किया।
posts.content:
अमर अपने माता-पिता का इकलौता बेटा था। दोनों ने लाड़ प्यार के आँचल में ममता की छाँव तले उसे पालकर बड़ा किया। उसकी हर आरजू को पूरा करने को तत्पर रहते थे जानकी और वासुदेव। ज्यों ज्यों अमर प्राइमरी से मिडिल, फिर मिडिल से हाई स्कूल का फासला तय करता रहा, उसकी ख़ूबियाँ भी प्रेम का पानी पाकर निखरती रही। शक्ल सूरत से तो वह मनमोहक था पर बुद्धिमान भी बहुत साबित हुआ। जब वह कालेज पहुँचा तो माँ-बाप के सामने अमेरिका जाकर पढ़ने की इच्छा प्रकट की, और साथ में वह वादे भी करता रहा कि वह पढ़ाई पूरी करते ही वापस आकर पिता के नक़्शे-कदम पर चलकर, यहीं पर बसेरा डालकर उन दोनों की देखभाल भी करता रहेगा। इस प्रकार माता पिता की ममता का क़र्ज़ भी उतारता रहेगा।

उसकी मीठी बातें और सलीकेदार सोच सुनकर जानकी और वासुदेव दोनों बहुत खुश हुए और अपनी बाकी तमाम उम्र की जमा पूँजी लुटाकर उसे बाहर रवाना करने में मदद की। यों वक्त आने पर अमर उनकी आँखों में नए सपने सजाकर उनकी आँखों से दूर चला गया। पहले अमर जल्दी जल्दी उन्हें ख़त लिखा करता था, उन्हें यहाँ की पढ़ाई के बारे में, अपने बारे में, माहौल के बारे में, बताता था। पर बहुत जल्द ही उन ख़तों की रफ्तार ढीली पड़ गई और एक वक्त ऐसा आया कि वासुदेव के लिखे हुए ख़तों का जवाब आना ही बंद हो गया। यों दो साल और बीत गए। निराशा आँखें उठाए हर सूनी डगर पर ख़त के इंतज़ार में पथराई आँखों से निहारा करती थी।

और एक दिन डाकिया एक बड़ा-सा लिफ़ाफ़ा उन्हें दे गया, जिसमें ख़त के साथ-साथ कुछ फोटो भी थे। जल्दी में वासुदेव ख़त पढने लगा जिसको सुनते सुनते उसकी पत्नी जानकी वहीं बेहोश हो गई। ये अमर की शादी के फोटो थे। शादी उसने अमेरिका में एक विदेशी लड़की के साथ कर ली थी और ख़त में लिखा था "पिताजी हम दोनों पाँच दिन के लिए आपके पास आ रहे हैं और फिर घूमते हुए वापस लौटेंगे। एक ख़ास बात है अगर हमारे रहने का बंदोबस्त किसी होटल में हो जाए तो बेहतर होगा। पैसों की ज़रा भी चिंता न कीजिएगा।"

यह खबर थी जो पढ़ने के बाद वासुदेव का बदन गुस्से से थर थर काँपने लगा, जिसे काबू में रखते हुए वह अपनी पत्नी को होश में लाने की कोशिश करते रहे और वहीं ज़मीन पर बैठकर बच्चों की तरह रोने लगे। उम्मीदें और अरमान सब बिखर गए, सामने अपनी ममता का महल टूटा हुआ खंडहर-सा लगा। जिसको अपने लहू से सींचा वो ही उस अपनेपन को भूल कर गैर देश को अपना मान बैठा। वह अपना तो किसी हाल में भी नहीं, मगर अपनों से भी बदतर है। ऐसा बेटा प्यार तो छोड़ो, नफ़रत के काबिल भी नहीं है, यही कुछ सोचते-सोचते आँख से गर्म आँसू बहने लगे। दूसरे दिन सुबह तार द्वारा बेटे को जवाब में लिखा, 
"तुम्हारा हाल पढ़ा पढ़कर जो दिल को धक्का लगा है उसी को कम करने के लिए हम पति-पत्नी कल तीर्थों के लिए रवाना हो रहे हैं, कब लौटेंगे पता नहीं और अब हमें किसी का इंतज़ार भी नहीं। इसलिए तुम पराये मुल्क को अपना समझ कर नए रिश्तों को निभाने की कोशिश करना। यहाँ अब तुम्हारा अपना कोई नहीं है."...वासुदेव

posts.title: Crush
posts.summary: Its about how I lost my chance to be with my crush even though we did have a shot together. Just because if stupid nerves
posts.content:
It is strange isnt it. How you just end up liking a person you met for the first time.
Same was with me. As I entered the class, I saw this guy with brownish hair that flopped on his head when he bobbed it up and down. His eyes were hidden behind the huge spectacles that covered most of his face. He had a button nose  and those lips, those oh so kissable lips.
I just stood there with my bag in my hand, staring at this stranger who had my insides shaken out. As his eyes flitted over me, and he noticed me staring at them, he quickly looked away just as I was about to step towards him to have an introduction.
My eyebrows rose as he acted as though he had never seen me. He just side stepped and went away. I sighed and sat on the nearest desk. 
As the lecture started, he entered and to my surprise, sat behind me. As I turned my head back to have a look at him, he offered me a tentative smile. I was momentarily blinded by it. I soon recovered and smiled back. 
Days passed as we began knowing each other. This small pounding of pulse as I looked at him each time became a solid proof of my crush on him. 
But I kept it a secret. Every moment shared with him, I was happy and free. He was funny in his own unusual way. A nerd, not a hardcore one though, he scored way more better than me in most of our tests. He always sticked to his group of friends but I was sure I was becoming a small part of it. 
Then came the time when he confessed. He confessed about having a crush, not on me, but this girl who was pretty and smart and fit. I realized he was completely out if my league. To get over my heartbrokenness, I decided to stop being friends with him. But before that could happen, came his bestie.
"He has a crush on you and not her"
He whispered in my ears leaving me confused as hell. Days continued as he acted strangely around me. People had come to know something privy that I wasnt aware of for they started teasing me with him. I, being a typical girl, blushed hard and saw that his cheeks too were tinted with a light shade of pink. 
I got suspicious so I asked him to meet me somewhere alone. I confronted him about the whole agenda and asked him to come clean. And he did
"I..I have a crush on you"
My ears still ring years after hearing that sentence, till date. I ran away, too scared of a commitment, I ran away. I have been crushing on him eversince. But havent  confessed to him yet. Coz we dont talk anymore like we used to do.

posts.content:
تیزی سے کلاس روم کی طرف بڑھتے ہوئے نینا منہ ہی منہ میں بڑبڑا رہی تھی ہاته میں ڈھیر ساری کتابیں تھیں اپنی ہی دنیا میں گم کلاس میں داخل ہوئی سر نادر کی آواز سن کر رک گئی اور بولی جی سر؟

posts.title: She choose to hide
posts.summary: sometimes its better to hide your feelings
posts.content:
She stood diplomatic towards relationship until she found him.

Like heavy rain after a long drought. It made her feel different ,a new sensation to which until then she turned her back.

The first moment when she saw him,he may not have noticed her.

But for her it turned to be a reason to smile without jocks and dance without music.When the world around call her insane she had a reason to ignore them all.

When her eyes caught hold of his black spectacl ,it turned to be a night mare.

She urge to see him all the time his presence made her shy and quiet and his absence made her sad.

He unknowingly became part of her day to day life.

She just wanted to say hai.but her throat freez at his sight and a shiver cought hold of her which she like the most.

Now she has a secret kept away from all the world deep inside her soul.

And....

It got dust but still kept as a secret .She wanted to shout it high and low. But she choose to hide....
Hide away from all the world.

Then..
The glory of the hidden mystery started fading. She returned to her normal life.
He adolsence gave her high punch and the pendulum of her mood is at equilibrium.

He walks away holding his girlfriend's hand and she feels nothing.

Still....

After these years . Whenever she finds a black spectacle passing by her heart beats like nothing.

Now she knew exactly why she choose to hide...

posts.title: Memory
posts.content:
I woke up outside.
I loosed my balance and sighed.

I am nothing.
Wherever I am, I am withering.

The bittersweet taste of this astonishing ride,

Would be just another catastrophic pride.

I went to a garden and saw a rose, 
and suddenly remembered;

Roses are delicate,
But it hurts you with it's thorns.
And you still try to get it,
Because it's stunning and reformed.

I was too curious to know, 
Where important people go.
They all ran out if my sight.
Including her who she left me in fright.

I looked up to see what beauty the night sky holds.

The stars and the moon was fascinating, 
Due to the fact that it was glimmering.

The rays of the moon were lovely and bright.
Until I realized it was a dull copy of the sun's light.

I tried to leave and run,
But then, instead I missed out the fun.

I go back to the scenery where the birds live free.
Going back without the pain and misery.

Then I met somebody who changed my life,
But those words she left hurt more than a knife.

She said she would never leave me, but it wasn't true. 
And know wherever I go, I alwats seem blue.

I wanted to leave, I wanted to forget,
I wanted to laugh, but it became a regret.

The pain in my heart
tries to heal itself with agony,
because of a tormenting memory.

It hurts me when I know,
I'll never go back where I will go.

Please take my advice to never look back,
and forget the obstacle track.
 
                                     -Fyrran

posts.title: Pag asa
posts.content:
Pag asa na gusto nating matupad, 

Pag asa na mukhang walang hahadlang, 

Pag asa na hindi mawawala, dahil nga sa mga pangako mo na mukhang Tama at hindi na mawawala.

Pero nasan na ? Nasan na ang pag asa na hindi mo ko iiwan, pag asa na ating tutuparin, pag asa na itinatak at ipinangako mo sakin. 

Pag asa na sabi mo walang bibitaw diba? 

Pero bakit ngayon sa mga bawat pag asa na naaalala ko na ipinangako mo ay wala na. 

Pag asa na sana ay matutupad pa kung kumapit kapa at hindi mo ko hinayaang mawala.

Edi sana lahat ng Pangako at Pag asa na gusto ko at gusto mo rin, EDI sana tinutupad na natin.

Kaso mukhang lahat ng Pag asa natin ay patuloy mo nang itinatanggal at patuloy mo nang binibitawan, dahil sa hindi mo na ako mahal at hindi mo na ako kayang ipag laban.

Kaya nga diba lahat ng pag asa natin ay nawala nalang bigla, dahil lang sa salitang Babye na.

Kaya Mahal kung San ka man tutungo at kung San ka man patungo, sana kahit minsan lang ay maalala mo manlang lahat ng Pag asa na gusto mo.

At kahit nga bumitaw kana sa lahat ng Pag asa na ipinangako mo saakin, eto parin ako Mahal itinutupad at umaasa parin sa Pag asa na babalik ka at maaalala mo ulit ako. 

Kaya Mahal kasama ka sa lahat ng pag asa Kong itinutupad. 

At kung hindi ka man makakabalik at hindi man matutupad ang Pag asa na aking pina pangarap, Mahal bibitawan narin kita.

posts.title: कुमुदिनी का फूल
posts.summary: माँ की प्रसन्नता का पारापार न था। किंतु अपने पुत्र एवं पुत्रवधू के 'हनीमून' नाम से उत्पन्न एहसास ने उसके सूने ह्रदय में एक विचित्र-सी गुदगुदी
posts.content:
उसके इकलौते पुत्र के विवाहोत्सव के पश्चात घर में गहरा सन्नाटा पसर गया। रिश्ते-नातेदारों के जाने के साथ-साथ पुत्र एवं पुत्रवधू भी हनीमून मनाने किसी पहाड़ी शहर को चले गए।


माँ की प्रसन्नता का पारापार न था। किंतु अपने पुत्र एवं पुत्रवधू के 'हनीमून' नाम से उत्पन्न एहसास ने उसके सूने ह्रदय में एक विचित्र-सी गुदगुदी उत्पन्न कर दी और वह कुछ प्रफुल्लित होती हुई अपने ड्राइंगरूम के एक कोने में रखी आराम-कुर्सी पर लेट-सी गई और अपने अतीत में गोते लगाने लगी।


आज से लगभग बाईस वर्ष पूर्व वह भी दुल्हन बनकर आई थी। तब वह मात्र सोलह वर्ष की थी। वह भी अपने पति के साथ हनीमून मनाने गई थी। पति-पत्नी कितने खुश थे। शादी के लगभग एक वर्ष के बाद उसकी गोद में उसका यह इकलौता पुत्र खेलने लगा था। किंतु जन्म के छः माह पश्चात ही काल ने उसकी खुशियों को अपना ग्रास बना लिया। उसका पति मात्र उसकी यादों में ही रह गया। तब उसके घर-परिवार के लोगों ने पुत्र के किशोर होते-होते तक उस पर पुनर्विवाह हेतु ज़ोर डाला था। उस बात को उसका पुत्र भी जानता था। किंतु उसका कहना था कि अपने सुख के लिए वह पुत्र के भविष्य को अंधकारमय नहीं बनाएगी। अपने पति के प्यार की निशानी को वह एक अच्छा इंसान बनाएगी। अपने पैरों पर खड़ा करेगी और उसका घर बसाने के पश्चात ही यदि समय एवं समाज ने अनुमति दी तो अपने विषय में विचार करेगी।


अतीत से अभी वह उभरी ही थी कि अतीत की एक अन्य घटना ने स्मरण में आकर उसे पुनः रोमांचित कर दिया... पति की मृत्यु के पश्चात पढ़ी-लिखी होने के कारण उसे उसी कार्यालय में अच्छी नौकरी मिल गई थी। वहाँ कार्यरत रहते-रहते उसका एक सहकर्मी भावना के स्तर पर उसकी ओर आकर्षित हुआ था। धीरे-धीरे दोनों में प्रेम हुआ और है भी। किंतु वह प्रेम सदैव एक मर्यादा में ही चलता रहा। किंतु उसके दायित्व ने उसे कहीं भी चूकने नहीं दिया। उसके सहकर्मी ने उसकी प्रतीक्षा में विवाह नहीं किया।


आज वह अपने सहकर्मी के विषय में सोच रही है, क्या इस उम्र में विवाह करना ठीक होगा? वह  अपने नए पति को सुख दे पाएगी? घर वाले क्या सोचेंगे? सबसे बड़ी बात, उसका पुत्र और बहू क्या सोचेंगे? क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा उन पर? क्या वह अपनी माँ से संबंध रखना पसंद करेंगे? क्या वह अपनी माँ के त्याग पर विचार करेंगे? इन संशयों के उभरते ही वह सहम गई। उसके मन में उठी गुदगुदी सिहरन में बदल गई। किंतु उसने निश्चय किया कि वह अपने मन की बात अपने पुत्र-बहू से अवश्य कहेगी।


हनीमून से लौटने पर उचित अवसर देखकर पुत्र ने कहा, ''माँ! क्या बात है? जब से हम लोग बाहर से लौटे हैं... तुम्हें बराबर खोया-खोया-सा देख रहे हैं। यदि भूल हुई हो तो क्षमा करना।''
''नहीं बेटा! तुम जैसे श्रवण पुत्र पर किस माँ को गर्व नहीं होगा?'' 
''तो अपनी परेशानी का कारण बताओ, माँ! तुम्हारी कसम...तुम्हारी खुशी के लिए मैं कुछ भी कर सकता हूँ। मैं जानता हूँ, तुमने मेरे लिए क्या कुछ नहीं किया। बताओ माँ।''
''बेटा! कहने से डरती हूँ।... मैं कहकर तुम्हें खोना नहीं चाहती।''
''तुम्हें मेरी कसम! अब कह भी डालो।''
''बेटा तुम अपने रवींद्र अंकल को तो जानते ही हो...''
बात को बीच में ही काटकर, ''हाँ! जानता हूँ! सब जानता हूँ माँ। मैं अब बच्चा तो नहीं। तुम्हारे संघर्ष एवं त्याग ने तो मुझे समय से पूर्व ही सारी दुनियादारी सिखा दी है माँ।''
''..........''
''हाँ माँ! मैं आज रवींद्र अंकल से मिला था। तुम्हीरी बहू को भी मिलवा लाया हूँ। हम लोगों ने तुम्हारे और उनके संबंध में फाइनल बात कर ली है बस! तुम्हारी स्वीकृति की आवश्यकता है... जिस दिन चाहो कोर्ट में चलकर तुम दोनों भी...!''
''बेटा!''
''आश्चर्य न करो माँ।''
माँ ने बेटे को चूम लिया।




डॉ. सतीशराज पुष्करणा

posts.title: अभिलाषा
posts.summary: nसर्दी का मौसम। गुनगुसी धूप। लान में मखली दूब।
posts.content:
सर्दी का मौसम। गुनगुसी धूप। लान में मखली दूब। एक तरफ रंग-भिरैगे फूलो वाले गमले तो दूसरी तरफ मोगरे की बल खाती बेल। ऐसे में पत्नी मूँगफलियाँ सेंक कर ले आई। गरमागरम। 

वे बरसों पहले की एक घटना से दुड़ गे। उस दिन भी पत्नी इसी तरह मूँगफलियाँ सेंककर कर लाई थी। नई ऩई शादी थी। मकान भी ढंग का कहाँ, खपरैल का एक कमरा और सेहन बस। सब तरफ गरीबी और बेरोजगारी के निशान। परन्तु पत्नी मानो इस सबसे अनजान। वह फलियाँ फोड़ती और एक एक दाना उसके मुँह में रख देती । उसका उल्लास देखने लायक था और तभी जो उसने कहा वह उनकी जिन्दगी में ताउम्र गूँजता रहा, "हर जनम में मुझे आप जैसा ही पति मिले।"

तब से अब तक गंगा में बहुत पानी बह चुका है। नौकरी-धंधा... बंगला-गाड़ी... बच्चे... बच्चों की पढ़ाई... उनकी शादियाँ... फिर एक एक कर के सबका चले जाना... दूर, अपने अपने कर्मक्षेत्र में। वे स्वयं भी एक स्थान पर टिक कर कहाँ रह पाए। नौकरी ऐसी थी कि भटकते रहे। पूरे देश का चक्कर काट-कूटकर अब वापस घर आए हैं। रिटायरमेंट के बाद फिर से पति पत्नी यों अकेले जैसे अभी-अभी शादी की हो। फर्क यही कि चेहके पर समय की छाप। अनुभव की आड़ी तिरछी रेखाएँ।

वे सम्मोहित से पत्नी को देखते रह गए। 

क्या देख रहे हो- 

कितनी अच्छी लग रही हो सुंदर

वह मुस्करा दी। फीकी-सी, इस अंदाज में जैसे उसे या तो पति की बात पर विश्वास नहीं है या फिर सुंदर होने न होने का अब कोई मतलब ही न रह गया।

अच्छा एक बार फिर वही बात कहो न।

कौन-सी समृतियों पर जमी धूल को झड़ने की कोशिश करते हुए पत्नी ने पूछा।

वही जो उस दिन कही थी। हर जन्म में मुझे आप जैसा ही पति मिले। पति ने याद दिलाया।

वह चुपचाप मूँगफलियाँ तोड़ती रही। मैनो छलके हटाकर जिंदगी का असल मकसद ढूँढ रही हो।

कहो न पति ने आग्रह किया।

क्या कहूँ पत्नी ने लंबी साँस छोड़ी। बल्कि घुट गई अनायास ही। आगे कहा- मैं अगले जन्म में औरत नहीं आदमी बनना चाहती हूँ।

By
माधव नागदा

posts.title: Fate Never Felt So Good Especially In This Town
posts.summary: A true short story I'm tinkering with about my past...which was rough.
posts.content:
Everything is different when you've got the cold taste of a steel between your teeth.  Your lips wrapped around the cold casing of the 9mm; you think fast.

Everyone always talks about what drug they took that gave them the best high, but this was nothing like that.  This feeling surpassed any anything I had felt up to that moment by far...and then I pulled the trigger.

I heard a click, but nothing happened.  Fate had spoken, the gun wasn't loaded...and God well he just proved to me his fucking existence.  Maybe I was destined for greatness, maybe there was something important for me...or maybe just maybe it was sheer dumb luck.

They say you always get a 2nd chance, this was my 3rd or 4th by now.  Who knows, who cares?  All I knew was that day I became a believer of what I'm still not sure of exactly.  I do know one thing, someone is watching over me.

I am not one of those simple kind of people.  Lying with the man of my dreams after making love to him for the first time made me tear up.  I'm sensitive, but not weak.  I have a hard shell to crack into, my husband being the only man whoever could.  Once you're in though, let's just say it's hard to get out.

My theory is there are two kinds of people in the world: people who think like me, who like to live fast and hard with no regrets or shame within certain limits and people who wish they could live like that.  The question is, where do you think you fall?  Are either of those choices even good choices?  How would you know?  The biggest question of all...do you want to know?

Some people spend their whole lives being way too careful and some aren't careful enough.  I know what you're thinking, "Why does it have to be all or nothing?  Certainly things can't be that black and white.  Isn't there any grey?"  I'm afraid, through my experiences I've learned that's just how life is.  From being a person floundering through life to a wife and mother...I still know that's just how life fucking is.  You're either living or dying, once I chose death now I choose life...didn't change how I truly operate, I still live everyday like it's my last.  My advice, choose wisely.

I always thought I was taking the easy way out but damn was I wrong.

Where I grew up is a complex town.  Most people who come here get swallowed up in the nothingness if they let it.  It's a town that truly never sleeps, especially for how small it is.  It's a historic town...but that doesn't even matter.  Not in this narrative, it means nothing to me.  Some people are proud to be from here...so much pride for a town that's falling to pieces in a state that's literally in shambles.  I ended up back here, giving birth to my son here, living the first year as a wife and mother here.  Now, we're crawling the walls and struggling looking for any options to get the hell out.  Move to a peaceful place we can settle and grow our new life from the ground up.  We won't get swallowed, we will make it out.  Don't let a place or person choose your fate.  You're in control of your life...question is what are YOU going to do about it?

posts.title: Live and Love your Life
posts.summary: You Live and Love your Life
posts.content: As a 22 year old, who is currently living a lie of everyones beliefs, I can say that I love my life. Yes, you read it right. I am living a lie of someones belief in me. Well, who is not? Every person in this world is living with a trust in the image of their life produced by others. Even the most lonely person in this world is living a lie that he is alone while he is not. There are other creatures, there is wind, there is sun that still makes up his life. The air he breathes, the water he drinks, the sun whose rays wake him up are together with him to make his day, his weeks, his months and his years till he gasps for one last breath of his life. Sometimes parents tell their student children, once you finish your education, you can get a really good job and settle down. Whereas the truth is that a person is never settled unless he reaches his goal which keeps on maturing as time passes. And every now and then this child/person is living a lie of a settled life. But no matter what we go through, we will be thankful for the experiences that have made us a much strong and a better person. It is not upto anyone else to live a life you lead. Your thoughts and your actions are cordially prepared into a unique system which gives you the ability to perform in the situations developing near you. Hence, love your life, eventhough it is a lie, because you are unique and so very special. I love my life and I hope you do too.

posts.title: Subtle Resistance
posts.content:
"And it's just like in the movies."  She muttered quietly to herself.  "Where lovers are just lovers and kisses don't mean anything..."

What an interesting thought coming from such a virginal perspective.  It's not like she knew or had any sort of experience.  All she had was ideas swimming in her mind.

But she felt a certain way in the way she watched her move.  An exciting feeling, foreign at best.  What was it?  Lust, love or something entirely different.

She silently watched the way she kissed all those other boys over the years.  Some sort of undeniable jealousy that she couldn't describe.  This was her best friend after all...and these feelings, oh these feelings overwhelmed and scared her.

For a moment she wished nothing but pain and malice on all who touched her, imagining what it felt like to have their hands on her waist.  She wanted their hearts to feel as if they would burst.  She already knew the end of this story before it began.  She would never love her that way.  She would never taste her skin.

She couldn't believe how bleak everything felt, like she had no future as she watched her friends skirt flowing back and forth as she walked.  She turned back at the girl and with a wave she was off to her next class.  She wondered how she assumed such a dark role.  She felt small and frail like a twig that would break.

The girl kept her secret for now.

Fir unke zindagi me ek hadsa hua jisne un dono koo aesa jhatka diya ke dono ki zindagi hilke reh gayi. Woh hadsa kuch is tarah tha. Us ladki ke parents mumbai gaye the. Ladki ghar par akeli thi. posts.title: Transcending Prologue
posts.summary:
[@] Who would have thought of adding doses of Opium in the simple bowl of punch would be just enough to spiral down the the remarkable Santini Ball of the century?

None but the in...
posts.content:
[@] Who would have thought of adding doses of Opium in the simple bowl of punch would be just enough to spiral down the the remarkable Santini Ball of the century?

None but the infamous Cassiopeia May Santini.

The Santini name had been the epitome of grace and family wealth since the rise of the common era; soft bars of classical music rung blissfully within the glazed chalk walls of their millennium old Basilica; flutters and folds of the grand ball gowns majesties the night air as a girl, nine years of age hid among the curtained round tables of guests.

No one noticed her for no one cared. Cassiopeia was only an upcoming heiress to the Santini fortune, she was only a figure for the future. With no power but her name, she would be just a blot in history, no more than a whisper of the wind.

And so the young girl laughed, a cup of powder, a voice within the back of her head buzzed, wouldn't be enough; but the stars have proved her wrong.

What ethereal barrier the guests had had long been gone. The classical music seemed but a cricket's tone in the bewildered shouts of dance and joy. Long gone were the boring sets of violins and oboes. Long gone were the courtesy and their manners.

'Welcome to the Santini's' Cassiopeia May grinned at the sight: gyrating bodies pounded, their etiquettes fading away with the night. Hairs once dutifully arranged like an ornament of flowers were now but a ruffle of blonde and brunette threads. The guests had been crazed out and Cassiopeia never had a better laugh.

"Look at that! Melisandre' of the Boliva family is--woah, I didn't see that coming", and so the highly esteemeed lady of the richest Romanian family wasted away into a torrid kiss with some mere waiter. 

He is good looking though, she chuckle from the tunnel vision her sight had from under the isolated table.

Cassiopeia's Jose Buzeta' creation, a ballgown of carnation and embedded jewels were meant to be a showstopper yet stayed hidden underneath the tables. What a grimy place for a 1.2 million dollar ball gown, but Cassiopeia couldn't care less.

A shuffle, a swish of the tablesnl curtain and Nathan Maxwell crept underneath posing by Cassiopeia's side, "Cassie, what did you do now?", his tantalizing hazel eyes grazed on her grinning face for any hint of mischief.

"I did absolutely nothing wrong, Nathan. They did", her voice was rather hunching to the information as she gave him the odd look and tilted her head towards the scene ahead.

"They're not alcoholics, especially not Mr. Bennet. I know you did something, Cassie and how could you tell that they-", her palms cut him out mid-sentence. Nathan's eyebrows furred and relaxed moments after he sighed, eyes rolling to the back of his head.

She was at it again, his young mind thought.

"All I did, was to pour some--sugar in the I don't know, the punch?", her eyebrows furred like his then bith arched forming a smirk at Nathan.

"Oh Cassiopeia..."

"What? They drunk too much of the alcohol that's why they're all crazy"

"Right, by alcohol you meant alcohol with some drugs?"

"Whatever", and Cassiopeia's eyes rolled away to the side of her head. He was always the party pooper. He was always on the right never looking to the fun side of going left.

"Live a little, man!" Her voice accentuated every words to mock his. When Nathan glared at her and yanked her out from underneath the table.

Cassiopeia crossed her arms, fresh air came in touch with her porcelain smooth skin, it made her tingle and her eyebrows arch as she spoke through a gritty teeth.

"You're so boring Nathan. I don't like you"

posts.title: CHANGE YOURSELF.
posts.content:
We dwell in a society where everyone is striving for the survival. Where the problems like water scarcity, load shedding, poor transport, goods hikes are making the peoples life miserable where ignorance to severe diseases is nearing the people to death and social media websities are the dominant agents for creating a polarized and chaotic society.
                  Consequently the rate of mental illnesses is escalating and still we in oblivion where we are heading? Unfortunately no one contemplates that our aggressive actions, our wild behaviour and our way to cope up things may have profound impact on others. It has been years we are facing the crises and now we have developed intolerance which is becoming a threat to our social life and our society in general.
                  We as a component of this countr are to be blamed for the topsy turvy enrooted in our society. Yes! We are blameworthy. We don't do things by ourselves, but we merely wish for someone to make the things easier and sort out the problems for us and yet we blame the politicions for all the mishaps which have sadly found a home. Perhaps we in our imaginar world are hoping for an angle to come down on earth and do something and we wnt to be dumbfounded?But none of usthinks that Allah has bestowed us with the aptitude and courage to chage our conditions. Despite that we leading a life a disable man lives. Ah! We are too stubborn, undoubtedl.
                   How many time you have heared the word "change"? Have you deeply thought of it for a while? If no, then it's a high time to put aside all things and think for the safety of your motherland. If yes, then you might have also thought how to change the worst and outrageous thing. But I am sure many of you failed to remove the dust rotting our society, the reason is, we judge others and pinpoint thrir flaws blatantly and consistently tell them about their wrongdoings which eventually feels annoyung and insultingto them. All in vain? You become exasperated. You are literally missing somethings in the process of change and if you want to work on it you should abandon all the habits that are obstacles in your way to accomplish your task.
                   Here I am talking about your inner self. In order to wipe out the pathetic things that can jeopradize our country as a whole. Firstly you need to change yourself because there is no denying the fact that change anyone with force or persuasion but you can compel them to change him or herself by creating a good example of yours.
This country is already flooded with hatred and faces casualties every now and then so why not spread love and peace. Nobody wants to be a victim or the culprit. Let's do it. Change your self.

posts.title: The Maybe and I
posts.content:
Maybe I've been so weak, 
Maybe it's because of your sick game of giving love and take it away,
Maybe I've gone too fast,
Maybe its my needing hand Or Maybe your selfish needs, 
Maybe You took so far,
Maybe I fell so hard,
Maybe its the distance between us,
Maybe because love is just unfair,
Maybe it's the faith that don't want us to be together,

but


i was there,
I was there sitting in the corner watching you silently  while you are busy changing the rules of our so called relationship.
I was there standing, seeing your empty heart while mine is slowly consuming of pain.
I was there Crying trying to figured out why you're so confusing.
I was there trying to hold on while your are trying to run away. 
I was there,
But you didn't see, you don't mind.. not at all 
Maybe that was the reason Why we fall apart.
and Maybe that's The reason why I choice to be on my own now.

posts.title: Pehla Kash - 2
posts.content:
For all those who are reading this I would suggest you to read the First part of this story. Pehla Kash - Shuruat. 

**Pyaar,  **Pyaar duniya main sab ko kabhi na kabhi ho sakta Hai par Arth ko Pyaar ho sakta Hai ye apne aap main bhaut badi baat Hai. Ladkio se hamesha beshak Ghira rehta tha wo par kisi se Arth ko Pyaar ho jaaye mujhe is baat pe bharosa nahi Hua. 

Pyaar aur tujhe, Mera sabse pehla sawaal hi Arth se ye tha kyuki mere dimaag main bhaut se sawaal chal Rahe they Pyaar ka aur Arth ki is halat main kya logic Hai.?  Maine phir poocha Bhai tujhe Pyaar ho gaya,  ye Kab Hua kaise Hua? 

Pata nahi kyu wo baat mujhse Kar raha tha par achanak kahi kho gaya tha. Araam se cigarette ke Kash ko apne andar mehsoos Kar raha tha. Itni shiddat se kisi ko cigarette peete hue pehli baar dekh raha tha main wo bhi apne us dost ko jo 4 Kash main poori cigarette khatam Kar deta tha achanak usko aisa Hua kya.  
Wo meri taraf dekh ke achanak hasne laga. Mujhe samajh nahi aaya Hua kya? 
Bhai sab sahi to haina? 
Kuch sahi nahi Hai bhai. Bhaut yaad Kara tujhe yaar Maine. Uske is jawaab main bhi na jaane kyu ek khaali pan sa tha. Uski Aankhe Nam thi par Aansu aankho se bahar nahi aa Rahe they. 
Ham sab ke saath kabhi na kabhi zindagi main Aise hota Hai jab ham kuch kehna chahte Hai par zubaan nahi khol paate aur aankhe Nam to hoti Hai par roo nahi paate. 

Bhai Maine bhi bht miss Kia tujhe par Hua kya ye tujhe kuch Bata to bhai kaise ho gayi Teri ye halat? Mere Is sawaal ke saath saath ek soch bhi thi aakhir aisa kon Hai jisne mere dost ki ye halat Kar di. 

Tujhe yaad Hai India Against Corruption ka Andolan jo Delhi main Hua tha. Anna Hazare waala? Usne kaha. 
Ye kya sawaal Hua bhai haa mujhe yaad Hai par iska Teri is halat se kya Lena dena? Maine chidchidate hue poocha. Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha kaha Corruption kaha Pyaar aakhir ye kehna kya chahta Hai? 

Bhai tere sawaal ka jawaab yahi se shuru hoga. Usne aisa kaha to mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha aakhir wo kehna kya chah raha Hai. 

Maine Bola ha bol. Usne Phir se cigarette ka ek Kash lia Ab tak wo cigarette khatam ho gayi thi usse Usne Zamee pe ragad ke bujhaya. Ye uski poorani aadat thi wo kehta tha cigarette ko kabhi pairo se nahi bujhana chahie. Mujhe dheere dheere lag raha tha ab tak wo pori Tarah badla nahi. 

5April 2011 mujhe yaad Hai ab bhi wo tareek. Main gaya tha Ramleela Maidan. Pehli baar ek Naya Gandi dikha tha apne zamane ka Anna Hazare main. Par mujhe nahi Pata tha Wo Anshan ek kranti laaega aur waha Jana meri Zindagi main ek badlaav.  
Main bas uski taraf dekh raha tha aur uski batain gaur se sun raha tha. 

Main bhi waha khade hoke naare laga raha tha aur dikhana chaah raha tha ki main bhi is muheem ke saath tha. Tujhe Pata hi Hai main jab koi bhi politics ke regarding Issue hota Hai usme itna khoo Jata hu ki over excited ho jaata hu. Isi over excitement mai main Kisi ke pairo ke upar chadh gaya. Achanak peeche se kisi ke Karhane ki Awaaz aayi aur main jaise hi Muda bas tabhi se meri poori zindagi badal gayi. 

Pehli baar koi itni khoobsurat ladki dekhi thi Maine. Neeli aankhe Lambe baal Gulaabi honth. Usne Neele rang ka Suit Salwaar pehan rakha tha aur Teri kasam bhai itni khoobsurat ladki kabhi nahi dekhi thi Maine. 

Maine usse sorry Bola par Wo meri taraf dekh rahi thi aur uski aankho main paani tha mujhe khood pe bhaut gussa aane laga Maine is ladki ke aankho main Aansu laa diya. Maine phir sorry kaha usne kaha it's OK aagey se dhyaan rakhna. 
Bas ye man ke chal tabhi Maine apna dil De diya. 

Tabhi achanak Stage pe Kumar Vishwas aa Gaye aur Achanak bheed chillane lagi aur wo khoo gayi us bheed main.

posts.title: Her After-effects
posts.content:
be4 I met u,
I thot I was happy,
nd I was,
but I had never known d rich contentment,
deep satisfaction,
nd total fulfillment
u brought 2 me
wen u came into my lyf.
be4 I met u,
I felt a lot of things,
gud things,
but I had never experienced
d indescribably intense
feelings I hav 4 u.
be4 I met u,
I thot I knew myself,
and I did,
but u looked deep inside me
nd found fresh new things
4 us to share.
No one made my heart pound,
my skin damp, everything juicy
through nd through...
lyk u.
None left me breathless,
panting wid excitement,
satisfaction, nd finally peace,
lyk u.
be4 u, dere were others,
but none captured
my mind, heart and soul forever...
lyk u.
Wen I think of u, u fill my mind;
There’s no more thinking room I find.
I’ve never had such thoughts before
I’m lost in u, whom I adore.
I think no more of other things,
Lyk common pleasures dat living brings.
I just think of u, nd I’m filled with dreams
Sometimes a man’s mind nd tongue
seem disconnected.
My mind realizes ur wonderfulness,
but my tongue myt fail 2 tell u.
Maybe, since my eyes nd brain
see how very obvious
ur lovely, endearing qualities r,
my tongue thinks
I don’t need 2 let u know.
In case dere is any doubt
abt wht I m thinking nd feeling,
I m writing it down for u:
I always think
u r d prettiest, smartest,
most wonderful, kindest,
most loveable girl
in all d world.
Wht is it about u dat makes me feel weak,
nd gives me d goose bumps whenever u speak?
Why does d sight of u fill me wid pleasure,
Like a spotlight dat shines on a glorious treasure?
r u so different from others I’ve known?
Wht qualities do u hav dat are urs alone?
Wht can it be dat fills up my heart?
nd makes me feel lost whenever we part?
There’s no easy answer 4 dis marvelous bliss,
4 d craving I feel whenever I miss,
4 the fire dat rages at the touch of ur skin,
4 the way my heart pounds 4 u way deep within.
It must be the attraction that I feel,
dat pulls like a magnet.
I could fight to get loose, but I’d rather give in
2 stay trapped by ur charms.

posts.title: What's special about her.
posts.summary: She is my favourite hello and hardest goodbye.
posts.content:
My love...well there is something incredible about her that makes me write about her again and again.
She is like my favourite hello and hardest goodbye. With her, I laugh my heart out and at times I cry a river.
I scream, I shout, I jump, I fly with her....well not practically but yeah technically she is always beside me (thanks to social apps)
Unpredictable that she is, trying to make her happy is an interesting puzzle I try solving every now and then. Her unpredictability is a gift considering the amazing surprising pics she throws at me.
She makes me realize that the judgmental looks of people around me are inconsequential.
Her presence makes me feel that no one can inflict the unwanted pain of seeking approval.
She is unconventional, when everyone chooses between right and left, she chooses to dig a tunnel right through the earth. She’s strange, erratic, funny, stupid, emotional, brave… Ah, I’m lost for words.
The day I met her, I met a different yourself…
And since that day, I have been meeting different versions of me and her.
And with all the unbelievably crazy things she does, I realise that nobody in this world is so “normal”. And shouldn’t be. Afterall, who and what defines what is “normal”?
She laughs at the stupidest of jokes and cries at the stupidest of reasons.
She understands, and yes she understands my unusual thoughts and feelings.
She’s a dreamer, free of inhibitions, free of rules set by tradition and society. What a nice family she has. (Still scared of her dad)
And being with her makes me realize my freedom too. There’s nothing called “spending quality time” in our friendship.
Because even when she’s not around, the whole time of my life feels like quality.
In dark days of life, she dreams of a brighter tomorrow with a smile.
I never saw the pain in her eyes, may be it’s masked with a faith or may be she is perennial source of positivity.
She has given me lots of memories…Sweet, stupid, embarrassing, all kinds of memories.
She takes away the shy me. And contagiously crazy that she is, I don't understand who is more crazy between us.
With her, life seems like an adventure at every turn. She challenges me and my thoughts.
At times, her impulsive nature pushes me to a brim, but I get back strong because nothing else feels calmer than her lovely face. (am very much hopeful like BADRI that one day... xD)
Living in the moment, long night talks, going against tides just to get a glance of her, solving her issues by considering them as my life's prime task and never realising the meaning of boredom, life has been anything but typical for me.
It’s like a never-ending movie or an addictive game with new twists and turns at every corner, a life of never let her GO.

posts.title: Overthinker
posts.summary: Does she overthinks everything I say?
posts.content:
Does she overthinks everything that I say?
Does she overthinks the texts I send her, the snaps in my stories the photos on my Instagram?
Does she overthinks everything that I say and do, because so many boys usually trick the girls.
They’ve made her believe that people turn around and say that they weren’t ready for a relationship, they were only looking for some fun, there was already another person in their life.
That’s why she doesn’t want to make assumptions. She’s afraid that she’s going to make the wrong ones. That she’s going to imagine a future with me and then am going to yank the fantasy away.
She overthinks, because she’s afraid to get cocky.
She’s trying to protect herself, which is why she’s going to think about all of the possible scenarios. That I want to date her. That I want to use her. That I want to destroy her.
That’s why she’ll analyze why I said ‘hello’ instead of ‘hey’. And she’ll put on her detective hat to solve the mystery of who the girl in my newest profile photo is instead of asking me. She’ll spend hours of her time trying to figure me out.
Of course, she does more than overthink the moves I make. She overthinks everything that she does around me
She overthinks the words in her texts, because she doesn’t want to look too eager, too desperate, but she doesn’t want to seem like she doesn’t give a crap about me, either..
She overthinks what she wears, because she doesn’t want to look like she’s trying too hard to impress me, but she doesn’t want to look like she’s too lazy to do her makeup and run a comb through her hair.
She overthinks what she posts to social media, because she’s worried that I’ll see it and will judge her before getting to know her better.
She understands that love is a fragile concept. That she could say one little thing that could make me chase her away. That one tiny mistake could cost her.
She wishes she could be herself around me, but she’s so scared that she’s become a censored version of herself. She’s trying to expose enough of her soul to keep me interested, but not enough to send me running.
After all, she overthinks everything, because she actually cares about me. Because I actually matter to her.
Because she has a huge heart that loves wildly.

posts.title: Definition of Love
posts.content:
Since I was in school, I was fond of collecting quotations from books, newspapers, articles and of course Internet too. For me, every line of those sentences contains truth that we never realize. Like a puzzle, it took me time to put the pieces at one until I come up with this whole picture of what those people are trying to say together.
While I was walking I stopped for a while and thought of the things that I don't have, and then I realized that the happiest of all people, don't really necessarily need the best that comes along their way. It's true that we don't know what we got until we lose them. But it's also true that we don't know what we've been missing until it arrives.
In the gateway of my heart, I put a sign, which says “No Trespassing” but love came laughing and said, “I enter everywhere”. Love knows no reason, love knows no lies,. Love defies a reason, love has no eyes. But love is not blind. Love sees but it doesn't mind. Love is when you take away the feeling, the passion, the romance and you still find out you still care for that person. Love is supposed to be the most wonderful feeling. It should inspire you and give you strength. But sometimes the things that give you joy can also hurt you in the end, it starts with a smile and develops with a kiss and ends with a tear.
When you love, you must not expect anything in return. If you do, you're not loving but investigating.
If you love, you must prepare to accept pain. For if you accept happiness you're not loving but using. Don't go for looks, it can deceive you. Don't go for wealth, even that fades away. Go for someone who makes you smile and make a dark day seem bright.
The beginning of love is to let those people be perfectly themselves and not to twist them to fit our own image, otherwise we only love a reflection of ourselves that we find in them. Never try to impress someone to make him/her fall in love with you, cause when you do, you'll have to keep that standard for the rest of your life.
A sad thing about life is that you meet someone who means a lot to you only to find out in the end that it was never bound to be and you just have to let him/her go. Maybe God wants us to meet the wrong people before meeting the right one, so that when we finally meet the right person, we should know how to be grateful for that gift. We oftentimes don't see the reason why we don't always get what we want. But in the end of it all, we realize what we wanted wasn't meant for us after all. Everything happens for a reason. When you feel down because you didn't get what you wanted, just sit tight and be happy because God is thinking of something better for you.
It hurts to love someone and not be loved in return, but what is most painful is to love someone and never find the courage to let that person know how you feel. It's always better to have found the courage to love even if you lose it in the end rather never finding love because you were afraid to face the challenge.The greatest regrets in our lives are the risks we didn't take. If you think something will make you happy, go for it! Remember that you pass this way only once.
Love no matter how hard you find it, it will remain invisible, no matter how hard you try, you won't get it. But when you're about to give it up, it comes. Sometimes the love we are looking for is right in front of us-too close for the eyes to see. So close your eyes and let your heart see itself. There are things you love to hear but you can never hear them from the person who says it with his heart. Just because someone doesn't love you the way you want them, doesn't mean they don't love you with all they have. There are so many stars in the sky, only some are radiant to be noticed. Among those you choose to ignore is the one which is willing to shine for you forever even if your glance remains elsewhere.
God never close doors without opening the window. He always gives us something better when He takes something away. Heartbreaks will last as long as you want and cut deep as you allow them to go. The challenge is not how to survive heartbreaks but to learn from them. In relationships, thank God when you're hurting or crying. There you are given a chance to measure the importance of your relationship with that person and with yourself. When you grow.. you don't become a better person because you experience suffering. We have no right to ask, "Why this had happen to me?" when sorrow comes, unless we ask the same question for every moment of happiness that come our way. When God puts a tear in your eye, it's because He wants to put a rainbow in your heart.
There are some things that we never want to let go of.. people we never want to leave behind. But keep in mind that letting go isn't the end of the world, it is rather the beginning of a new life. The brightest future will always be based on a forgotten past; you can't go well in life until you let go your past failure or heartbreaks. To let go is not to deny but to accept. To let go is not to regret the past but to grow and to live for the future. To let go is to fear less and love more.
Don't be afraid to break someone's heart, because that's how the relationships when you are young-they are the stepping stones for the main one. Follow the heart. It might not always be right but despite the pain, you'll have the memories that will make you smile, even ones and even rare while . It is better not to have someone you love right now, but have them later, than be with them right now but lose them forever. Love has its time, seasons and reasons. You can't ask it to stay, you can only embrace it as it comes and be glad for a moment in your life while it was yours. Each of us is given a pocketful of time to spend however we may. We use that will. We shall go and the feeling shall die, it might be too late when you open your eyes. Don't be busy planning the life you're going to have than you fail to appreciate the one you've already been given/dream what you want to dream, go where you want to go, be who want you to be because you have only one life and one chance to do all things you want in your life. We are never given dreams without the power to make them come true.
A heart truly in love never loses hope but always believes in the promise of love, no matter how long the time and how far the distance. Never say goodbye when still want to try-never give up when you feel you can still make it-never give up when you feel you can still take it-never say don't love the person anymore when you can't go. True love doesn't have an ending because true love never ends.

posts.title: Don't Wanna Know!
posts.content:
Some songs appear to be especially for you. Maybe the writer and the singer were thinking about you only while writing that song. 
Don't Wanna Know by Maroon 5 was the same song that I used to think when we were apart. 

Maybe because of the way you were behaving at that time. I just wanna tell you loving you was never easy. There is a very big misconception in the society that opposite attract many a times opposite don't even get on same issue at any point. 
It was like there is a huge gap between us. 
The main problem started with our upbringing you were the baton of Feminism and I was born Male chauvinist. 
You remember the way we used to fight on different issues. 
You were of the Ideology of Freedom at the cost of anything and I was always surrounded by boundaries set up by the society. 
You like the Movie where girl is shown living freely even at the cost of pain it induced in her family but I don't like movie lie that. 

Even on foods you were like the sophisticated Continental food lover and I used to enjoy the street food more than the food in fancy restaurants. 
You were all into the Edm and I was still the Gazal and Qawwali lover. 

You like night parties and I was always a morning person. 

I don't think we were meant to be together ever we challenged the laws of nature. 

Now you are searching for me in the night and I am trying to find you in the morning.
